mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS record_id, r.question_id AS question_id, r.outline_id AS outline_id, r.is_correct AS correct, r.answered_at AS answered_at FROM user_answer_record r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND r.is_correct IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.question_id, r.answered_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT q.outline_id AS ref_id, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM rk_question q WHERE q.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND q.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY q.outline_id
SELECT qk.kp_id AS ref_id, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM rk_question q JOIN rk_question_kp qk ON qk.question_id = q.id WHERE q.subject_id = #{subjectId} AND q.status = 'PUBLISHED' GROUP BY qk.kp_id

SELECT DISTINCT r.user_id AS user_id, r.subject_id AS subject_id FROM user_answer_record r WHERE r.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND r.user_id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT a.user_id FROM user_answer_record a WHERE a.is_correct IS NOT NULL AND a.answered_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ) LIMIT #{limit}
